item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 12/Dec/2021
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will bring cool and dry weather to Guangdong in the next couple of days. With the monsoon moderating midweek this week, temperatures over Guangdong will rise slightly. Another surge of the northeast monsoon will affect southern China in the latter part of this week. Besides, a tropical cyclone will form over the western North Pacific this week, and will move in the general direction of the vicinity of the Philippines.
